content: What is the diameter of the round window in ZETA?

No data: no structure named ['round window']. Available: Bone, Carotis Interna, Chorda Tympani, Cochleovestibular nerve, External Auditory Canal, Facial Nerve, Incus, Malleus, Scala Tympani, Scala Vestibuli, Sinus Dura, Stapes, Tympanic Membrane.

CochleaHub does not have data for the diameter of the round window in specimen ZETA. The available structures in the dataset do not include "Round Window" as a separate measurement category. 

The structures currently available for per-structure measurements are: Bone, Carotis Interna, Chorda Tympani, Cochleovestibular nerve, External Auditory Canal, Facial Nerve, Incus, Malleus, Scala Tympani, Scala Vestibuli, Sinus Dura, Stapes, and Tympanic Membrane.

If you need information about nearby structures like the stapes or tympanic membrane, I can provide those measurements instead.
